responsibility: This definition module declares a Logitech-compatible raw block memory API for GNU Modula-2. It specifies procedures for forward and backward moves, zeroing and patterned filling, block equality tests, and searching for a byte pattern in a memory region, all operating on SYSTEM.ADDRESS ranges rather than typed arrays or files.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition interface for the BlockOps pair, declaring raw memory-block procedures over SYSTEM.ADDRESS; the companion BlockOps.mod contains the concrete loops and Builtins memcpy/memmove/memset calls.
